question.text: What is the strike price interval for INR-based exchange-traded currency options?

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook prescribes a Rs. 0.25 strike-price interval for INR-based currency options (for example 74.50, 74.75, 75.00, 75.25), with a minimum of 12 ITM plus 12 OTM plus 1 near-money strikes available at any time. The Trap: The Rs. 0.25 interval is specific to INR-pair options; cross-currency options have different intervals such as USD 0.005 for EURUSD/GBPUSD and JPY 0.5 for USDJPY. Note: Workbook references — p.88 (Rs. 0.25 interval and minimum 12 ITM + 12 OTM + 1 near-money strikes) and p.89 (cross-currency intervals).
